passage:
Hi Daniel,

I hope you and Mia are settling into the new apartment. I wanted to update you on my plans for the summer, since you asked whether I could help with your move-in party.

Unfortunately, my company has asked me to lead a training session in Calgary during the last week of June, so I will miss the party on the 28th. I am disappointed, because I was looking forward to finally meeting your neighbours and trying the barbecue you keep talking about. The good news is that the training only lasts four days, and I should be back in Vancouver by July 2nd.

I was thinking I could come over the following weekend instead. I could bring the folding table and chairs you wanted to borrow, and if you still need help hanging the shelves in the living room, I can bring my drill too. Just let me know whether Saturday or Sunday works better, because I have a dentist appointment on Saturday morning.

Also, my sister Laura is looking for a new place and wondered if your building has any units available. She works from home, so she needs a quiet apartment with a second bedroom she can use as an office. Could you ask your building manager when you get a chance?

Talk soon,
Priya

questions.prompt: Priya is writing to Daniel mainly to
options: invite him to a training session
explain why she cannot attend his party
ask him to help her move

reply.text:
Hi Priya,

Thanks for letting me know. Of course we will miss you at the party, but work comes first. Congratulations on being asked to {{1}}.

Coming over the weekend after you return sounds great. Since you are busy on {{2}}, let's plan for Sunday afternoon. Please do bring the {{3}}, because the shelves are still sitting on the floor.

I spoke to our building manager yesterday. There is a two-bedroom unit opening up in August on the top floor, which should be {{4}} enough for Laura to work in. I will send her the manager's {{5}} so she can book a viewing.

See you soon,
Daniel
